_about: Tools whose live (editor) step used the retired UnrealBridge plugin and is not yet ported to MCP. BridgeClient refuses them before any network call. Remove an entry when the tool is ported; see ../unreal-engine-mcp/references/porting-legacy-writers.md.

asset_cleanup.instead: AssetTools.get_referencers, then a reviewed builtin_mcp.py batch plan of AssetTools.delete with AssetTools.exists readbacks

flipbook_ue_pipeline.instead: build the atlas with vfx-flipbook-generator, then a builtin_mcp.py batch plan: TextureTools.import_file, MaterialInstanceTools set_* and NiagaraToolset_System.SetRendererData, each with a readback

live_asset_verify.instead: niagara_audit.py (renderer materials) plus ObjectTools.get_properties on the texture and material

niagara_asset_assistant.instead: apply the generated plan with NiagaraToolset_System tools through builtin_mcp.py batch, then niagara_audit.py
niagara_asset_assistant.offline: plan-template, new-plan, repair-plan, render-script and export-md

niagara_param_sweep.instead: NiagaraToolset_System.SetStackInputData or AddUserVariables per step, with EditorAppToolset.CaptureViewport

ue_write_helpers.instead: ObjectTools.set_properties or NiagaraToolset_System Set*Data through a builtin_mcp.py batch plan
